summary: Initial hardening practices: minimize system administrator accounts (root on AAP nodes can decrypt stored credentials), give no local access to non-admins, separate duties with different credentials per automation component, and limit the UI system administrator role to the fewest users.
questions: Why limit root access on AAP nodes?
